Hints: Replace one variable with its equivalent expression, then solve and substitute back.
Solution: System: y=4 × x+3; 2 × y-x=20. Isolate y: y=(4)x+(3). Substitute into the other equation: (-1)x+(2)[(4)x+(3)]=20. Combine: (7)x=14, so x=2. Then y=(4)(2)+(3)=11. Check both equations: -4(2)+1(11)=3; -1(2)+2(11)=20. Requested answer: 2.
